title: First Lessons: Stars
introNarration: Mentor Lumen sets your first work. Look this hearth. Find Flint in the South Orchard. Come back.
reminderNarration: Look the Hearth of Stars. Visit the South Orchard. Attack the dummy. Then talk Lumen.
completionNarration: Lumen marks a line and stops. Stars have your name, if not yet your measure.

objectives.label: Look around the Hearth of Stars.
